about_the_game:
A simple rhythm game where you hit beats as they come down the lanes. Level editor included.

Key features

🎵  32 surprisingly groovy royalty free songs to play

🎮  Both keyboard and gamepads are supported simultaneously

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦  Compete locally with up to 4 people

📌  Bookmark/hide tracks

🏆  High scores for each level

✏️  Built in level editor

⬆️  Share, play and rate levels on the workshop

Level editor

The same level editor that was used to create the built-in tracks is available to you too. What will you use it for? Share your masterpieces with the community through the workshop.

Only have one controller?

Don't worry! Any combination of gamepads and keyboard controls can be used simultaneously, so no one is ever left out. Note that typical keyboards only permit up to 5 keystrokes at once, so the gameplay experience may deteriorate if you have too many people sharing a keyboard.

Organise your library

Bookmark the tracks you like the most, and hide the tracks you don't enjoy. No time wasted scrolling past music you don't enjoy

Audio previewing

While browsing the menu, the key moment of the song will play right from the menu. Or if you need silence to think, you can disable this feature. 

High scores

Each track comes with its own local scoreboard, so you know when you've just beaten your own record. Or your friends can set you impossible records to beat. 

Pause recovery

When unpausing the game, you'll be given a 3 second grace period to get ready before the track resumes again.

Difficulty

Tracks can include multiple difficulties, ranging from easy, all the way to impossible. You can also play in blindfolded mode which only reveals the pucks right before they hit the pad.
